inputs.original_text: White House border czar Tom Homan on Tuesday did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are “afraid of.” Homan’s comments, made during an appearance on “The Charlie Kirk Show,” are the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers over whether they...
inputs.modified_text: Border Czar Tom Homan appeared on The Charlie Kirk Show this Tuesday and rightly refused to rule out immigration enforcement at polling places. He called the Democrats out directly on what they're so afraid of, and that question gets to the heart of the matter. This country was built on the rule of law and national sovereignty, so protecting our elections from outside influence is plain common sense. The left's resistance and endless back-and-forth only reveals how little regard they have for personal responsibility or preserving our cultural continuity when it comes to safeguarding American votes and borders. Firm authority like this is exactly what we need to uphold order and protect what matters.
